source.title: Teichbach Waterfall in Teichbach Valley near Gütenbach/Simonswald, Baden-Württemberg , Germany The Teichschlucht is a wildly romantic gorge in the southern Black Forest. A narrow stream has carved its way deep into the rock here, creating a narrow, rocky landscape with steep slopes, waterfalls, and moss-covered rocks. Narrow paths and footbridges lead through the valley, making the gorge an impressive natural experience. The adjacent protected forest is a strictly protected forest area. In a protected forest, humans no longer interfere with natural development. Old trees are allowed to die and remain as deadwood, creating a pristine, structurally rich forest with high biodiversity. Mosses, fungi, insects, and rare bird species find valuable habitat here. The pond gorge and protected forest exemplify the wild, natural side of the Black Forest and stand for consistent nature and species conservation.
source.creator: Dietmar Rabich
